recent.text: Mark Daigneault on Bennett Stirtz: "He had an aggression tonight offensively that we need out of him.. We need him to be aggressive... I thought he did that tonight." Daigneault says Stirtz also had one of his best defensive games tonight as well.
recent.author: Brandon Rahbar

recent.text: Mark Daigneault asked by @AndrewKSchlecht about Aday Mara's intelligence: "He's big and he's jolly and he rim protects and he's skilled and that's the thing that people see. I think the thing that can be invisible is #1 his intelligence... and #2 he's a big time competitor..
recent.author: Brandon Rahbar

recent.text: Mark Daigneault says Kenrich Williams changed the game with his energy in the 3rd quarter: "He just went in there with an edge and a fight that was contagious.. I thought he was a huge catalyst in the game tonight."

recent.text: Any win without the collective talent of Jalen Williams, Chet Holmgren, Cason Wallace and Alex Caruso is a good win. A 16 point comeback win fueled by SGA, Jared McCain and OKC's two rookies is a really good one and one the Thunder needed.
recent.author: Brandon Rahbar

recent.text: Thunder improve to 10-6. 16 point comeback win. 6-1 at home. 2-1 in NBA Cup play. SGA: 40 PTS/4-7 3PT/7 AST Mara: 22 PTS/16 REB/3 BLK Stirtz: 18 PTS/4-6 3PT McCain: 18 PTS... all in the 2nd half Next up: Heat in Miami on Sunday.
